AddFaceRecord.description_en: Adds a face image to a specified face library
AddFaceRecord.description_zh: 添加人脸图片到指定人脸库

AddressCompareIntl.description_en: Compares the similarity of two addresses

AddressVerifyIntl.description_en: Verifies whether a specified address belongs to a user's residential address based on telecommunications service provider capabilities, using a phone number and an address (or coordinates)
AddressVerifyIntl.description_zh: 常用地址核验 API 基于运营商能力，通过手机号码、地址（或经纬度），验证传入地址是否属于该用户的常住地址

BankMetaVerifyIntl.description_en: Provides bank card element verification (two-element, three-element, and four-element) API operations
BankMetaVerifyIntl.description_zh: 银行卡要素（银行卡二要素、银行卡三要素和银行卡四要素）API接口

CardOcr.description_en: Provides server-side ID card and certificate OCR capabilities

CredentialRecognitionIntl.description_en: An API operation that uploads credential images, including utility bills and credit card statements, and uses Qwen-VL to intelligently fetch billing addresses and names
CredentialRecognitionIntl.description_zh: API接口，上传凭证图片，包括：水电煤、信用卡账单等，通过通义VL智能提取账单地址及姓名

CredentialVerifyIntl.description_en: Provides the API operation for the credential verification service. This operation uses a large language model to detect image tampering, forgery, and image quality issues in submitted credential images
CredentialVerifyIntl.description_zh: 凭证核验服务的API接口。接口可以将传入的凭证图片通过大模型进行图片篡改及伪造检测、图片质量检测

DeepfakeDetectIntl.description_en: Detects deepfake risks in facial images

DeepfakeDetectIntlStream.description_en: ID Verification provides face deepfake detection capabilities, which can be integrated independently through API calls
DeepfakeDetectIntlStream.description_zh: ID Verification 提供了人脸Deepfake检测能力，可以通过接口的形式单独接入

DeleteVerifyResult.description_en: Deletes data related to a user authentication record
DeleteVerifyResult.description_zh: 删除用户认证记录相关数据

DocOcr.description_en: Provides server-side card and certificate OCR capabilities

DocOcrMax.description_en: Recognizes global identity documents through OCR

DocOcrMaxV2.description_en: Recognizes identity documents worldwide through OCR

DocOcrV2.description_en: Provides server-side card and certificate OCR capabilities

EkycVerify.description_en: Provides a server-side-only API for the eKYC solution

EkycVerifyV2.description_en: Provides a server-side-only API for the eKYC solution

FaceCompare.description_en: Uses facial recognition technology to compare and verify two input face images, returning the face comparison result and similarity score
FaceCompare.description_zh: 通过人脸识别技术，可以对传入的两张人脸图片进行比对验证，返回人脸对比结果和相似度分值

FaceCompareV2.description_en: Compares two face images using face recognition technology and returns the comparison result and similarity score
FaceCompareV2.description_zh: 通过人脸识别技术，可以对传入的两张人脸图片进行比对验证，返回人脸对比结果和相似度分值

FaceDuplicationCheckIntl.description_en: Performs server-side liveness detection and face duplication check (FaceDuplicationCheckIntl) for scenarios where SDK integration is not feasible. Submits face images through the API to verify whether the user is a real person, compare the face against a retained face image for identity verification, search face libraries to determine whether the face already exists, and automatically register the face to a specified face library after successful verification
FaceDuplicationCheckIntl.description_zh: 人脸重复性检测（FaceDuplicationCheckIntl）适用于无法集成 SDK 的场景，通过 API 接口传入人脸图片，实现以下功能：验证用户是否为真人、与留存人脸进行比对验证身份、在人脸库中进行检索判断是否存在、支持验证通过后自动将人脸注册到指定人脸库中

FaceGuardRisk.description_en: Server-side API for the international Face Guard service
FaceGuardRisk.description_zh: 国际人脸保镖纯服务端接口

FaceLiveness.description_en: Provides the server-side API for passive liveness detection
FaceLiveness.description_zh: 静默活体纯服务端能力Api

FaceLivenessV2.description_en: Detects whether a face in an image is from a real person by using the API operation. This service combines the Qwen-VL large model for in-depth forgery risk detection to determine face liveness
FaceLivenessV2.description_zh: 指通过API接口传入提前获取的人脸图片进行真实人脸检测的服务，结合Qwen-VL大模型深入检测伪造风险，判断是否为真人

FaceVerifyIntl.description_en: Performs real face detection by receiving pre-captured face images through the API operation. The algorithm primarily identifies whether a face is a screen replay or printed photo type of basic render liveness attack, and supports comparison with another face image to authenticate whether they belong to the same person
FaceVerifyIntl.description_zh: 通过API接口传入提前获取的人脸图片进行真实人脸检测的服务，算法主要识别人脸是否为屏幕翻拍、打印图片此类基础呈现活体攻击的类型 ，并支持与另一张人脸图片比对验证是否为同一人

FraudResultCallBack.description_en: Calls the eKYC global anti-spoofing callback operation

Id2MetaPeriodVerifyIntl.description_en: Verifies the validity period of an identity document as a two-factor authentication element
Id2MetaPeriodVerifyIntl.description_zh: 身份二要素有效期核验

Id2MetaVerifyIntl.description_en: Verifies the authenticity and consistency of a name and ID card number against an authoritative data source
Id2MetaVerifyIntl.description_zh: 传入姓名和身份证号，通过权威数据源验证其真实性和一致性

IdnAuthorityVerifyIntl.description_en: Verifies the identity of an Indonesian user by calling the authoritative source API in a standalone business scenario
IdnAuthorityVerifyIntl.description_zh: 在独立业务场景中，直接调用权威源接口完成印尼用户身份核验

Mobile2MetaVerifyIntl.description_en: Verifies the identity of a phone number owner by using two-factor authentication

Mobile3MetaVerifyIntl.description_en: Verifies the authenticity and consistency of a phone number, name, and ID card number against an authoritative data source. If the information is inconsistent, returns the reason for the inconsistency
Mobile3MetaVerifyIntl.description_zh: 传入手机号、姓名、身份证号，通过权威数据源验证其真实性和一致性，如果不一致，返回不一致的原因

TempOssUrlIntl.description_en: Retrieves a temporary URL for a file
